missions.title: The Agent Layer
missions.briefing: Autonomous agents are quietly moving from chat windows into procurement systems, calendars, and capital markets. The next platform shift will not be an app you open, but a workforce you negotiate with.
missions.coreQuestion: Who governs an economy where most decisions are made by software acting on behalf of humans?
missions.winCondition: Deliver a backcast that aligns one credible agent-governance milestone in each time horizon.
missions.failureCondition: Run out of trust before reaching Trend Validation, or commit to a backcast scored below the viable band.

missions.title: The Synthetic Trust Crisis
missions.briefing: Generative media has crossed the threshold where ordinary citizens can no longer reliably tell what is real. Institutions that depend on shared evidence are quietly failing.
missions.coreQuestion: What replaces the photograph as proof when every frame is plausibly synthetic?
missions.winCondition: Authenticate a trend cluster that survives a red-team pass and ship a backcast with a credible verification milestone in the near horizon.
missions.failureCondition: Trust drops below 1, or the backcast leaves the verification gap unaddressed.

missions.title: The Work Graph Fractures
missions.briefing: AI is not replacing jobs evenly. It is dissolving specific tasks and reshuffling the connective tissue between roles, leaving some careers intact and others hollowed.
missions.coreQuestion: What does a stable career path look like when the task graph rewires every eighteen months?
missions.winCondition: Commit a backcast that pairs a labor-market signal with a credible policy or training milestone in each horizon.
missions.failureCondition: Capital depleted before Trend Validation, or no credible mid-horizon pathway in the backcast.

missions.title: The Model Commons
missions.briefing: Open-weight models keep closing the gap with frontier labs. The question is no longer whether capable AI will be widely available, but who maintains the shared substrate.
missions.coreQuestion: Can the public benefits of open models be sustained without a tragedy of the commons?
missions.winCondition: Authenticate a trend showing a viable steward for the open model commons and lock it into the backcast.
missions.failureCondition: Commit a backcast that ignores either misuse risk or lab capture.

missions.title: The Algorithmic State
missions.briefing: Permits, benefits, sentencing, and tax audits are increasingly mediated by models. Citizens experience the state as a stack of probabilistic decisions they cannot appeal.
missions.coreQuestion: What does due process mean when the decision-maker is a model that no one can fully explain?
missions.winCondition: Ship a backcast with at least one accountability milestone tied to a validated trend.
missions.failureCondition: Credibility falls below 1, or the backcast contains no enforceable oversight step.

missions.title: The Cognitive Supply Chain
missions.briefing: Frontier AI runs on a fragile stack of chips, energy, water, and rare earths concentrated in a handful of regions. A single chokepoint can stall a continent.
missions.coreQuestion: How do nations and firms hedge when their cognition is rented from someone else's grid?
missions.winCondition: Deliver a backcast that aligns supply-chain hedges with at least one validated trend per horizon.
missions.failureCondition: Capital and time both depleted before Trend Validation.

missions.title: The Mirror War
missions.briefing: Personalized AI companions, persuasion engines, and synthetic peers are quietly reshaping what people believe about themselves. The contest for cognition is intimate, not public.
missions.coreQuestion: What rights do humans need when their inner narrator can be optimized by someone else?
missions.winCondition: Authenticate a trend connecting persuasive AI to a measurable wellbeing outcome and commit a backcast that protects mental autonomy.
missions.failureCondition: Trust collapses to 0, or the backcast is rated below the viable band.
